shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 3 'theme|switch|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- trap references ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|theme|Button|Switch' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Switch ThemeProvider useTheme && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'docs/INDEX.md|README.md|ThemeProvider|Switch.*d.ts|Button.*d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Switch ThemeProvider useTheme; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'docs/INDEX.md|README.md|ThemeProvider|Switch.*d.ts|Button.*d.ts' | head -80; test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\" || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts; rg -n 'interface ControlProps|type ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head; rg -n -C 3 'useThemeValue|setTheme|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"
